notes.title: June 7, 2025 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Gameplay Update:[/h2]
This update improves the feel of the "Parry" mechanic. You can now activate "Parry" instantly during most actions (such as attacking), interrupting the current move or canceling its recovery state. Previously, Parry could only be used while standing still with no action or recovery animation playing.

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
Fixed a known bug where starting a New Game Plus in Story Mode still required manually selecting Story Mode for it to take effect.

notes.title: June 3, 2025 Update Notes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the final boss in the bad ending had significantly more HP than intended.

notes.title: Launch Week Update Summary & Upcoming Features
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you so much for all the amazing support over the past few days! I also truly appreciate everyone who pointed out areas where the game still needs improvement. As an inexperienced solo developer, this has been an incredibly valuable experience. Thank you for giving me the chance to grow. I’m working hard to make this game better and more worthy of your love—your support is my only source of motivation![/h2]

[h1]This update includes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added fast travel to the surface: you can now select "Teleport to the Surface" from any save point.
[*] Improved save point guidance, and added a new save point during the story transition from Day 1 to Day 2.
[*] Fixed several uncommon minor bugs based on user feedback.
[*] Changed the default option for the final boss fight and Story Mode New Game Plus from “Yes” to “No” to avoid accidental selection.
[*] Added a detailed description of Story Mode New Game Plus content.
[*] Added sound effects to the protagonist’s ultimate move.
[/list]

[h1]What’s coming in future updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Free or very low-cost DLC: Once I’ve fixed the issues that have been heavily discussed in reviews, I’ll begin work on a DLC that extends the story by seven more in-game days. Stay tuned~
[*] Map system.
[*] Monster encyclopedia.
[*] Ongoing bug fixes and feedback review every day.
[/list]

notes.title: June 2 Update Notes (Part 2)
notes.notes: Fixed a rare but critical bug that could prevent a randomly selected boss from spawning properly.

notes.title: June 2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
It is now possible to directly select Story Mode from the game title screen.
Easy Mode includes extremely high stats, all items set to 99, and all story branch conditions automatically fulfilled.
You no longer need to complete a bad ending first to unlock Story Mode New Game Plus.

notes.title: Update Notes – June 1, 2025
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you all for the feedback since launch! This update includes:[/h2]
- Fixed several known bugs
- Resolved an issue where certain bosses could escape the map when using specific skills
- Nerfed all bosses' mechanics/stats to reduce overall difficulty
- Specifically reduced the stats and surface attack damage of the giant sandworm in Layer 2
- Fixed a bug where New Game Plus in Easy Story Mode would start even after a good ending; now it will only be available after a bad ending

[h2]Coming in future updates:[/h2]
- Map feature
- Monster encyclopedia
- Possible controller support improvements
- Fixes for more undiscovered bugs

notes.title: Story Mode New Game Plus is now available~!
notes.notes: If you didn’t get the good ending in a playthrough, you can now start a second playthrough in Easy Mode.

notes.title: “Welcome to Planet E1d0r4d0” is out Now！
notes.notes:
Hillo, Vuekora here, I’m the developer of “Welcome to Planet E1d0r4d0”.

This is the very first game I ever made, and naturally, it holds a special place in my life—it’s a mark on my soul that I’ll never forget. Honestly, I wouldn’t be surprised if it’s the last thing I think about before I die.

I started working on this game when I was 19 and fresh out of high school, and it’s been three years now. Even though it’s a solo dev project, I’ve been lucky to meet so many amazing people along the way. Thanks to all their support, what started as a small wish has finally taken root and grown.

“E1d0r4d0” is the very first title from LuluGames, and it marks my first step into the blended gameplay genre of visual novel and 2D action-adventure gameplay. It was a bit of an experiment—but it’s proved to be surprisingly viable, and I’m incredibly grateful it managed to gain some attention and love along the way.

Throughout those three years of developing, I’ve been slowly refining the gameplay loop, what started as a super rough and cringey little demo went through countless rewrites, rebuilds, and overhauls before reaching a point where I could finally say, “Yeah… I’m kinda proud of this.” Feeling that I’m actually growing bit by bit in a genre I love has been deeply fulfilling, it reminds me that I’m alive and still pushing forward. Maybe finishing and releasing what was originally just a small test project is just my way of sharing with the world the joy of a first newborn cry.

I truly hope you enjoy everything this game has to offer. And moving forward, LuluGames (which is just me, haha) will keep exploring what’s possible in this gameplay genre. I believe that in the not-too-distant future, I’ll be able to bring you even more polished and meaningful projects. Stay tuned!
